newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Showpla says good response to rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Showpla says good response to rights issue.

text.p: Plastic components maker Showpla Asia Ltd said on Monday it had received a good response to plans to list 80 million new ordinary shares on the Osaka Securities Exchange.

Kenzo Nakagawa, Showpla chairman and managing director said the response was a reflection of "the confidence (investors) have in our operations and the growth potential in our next phase of business expansion in emerging economies globally".
Showpla said in a statement the shares, offered in a renounceable rights issue, had been subscribed 102.79 percent.
The Osaka listing will be in addition to Showpla's listing on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.

Showpla's major shareholders -- Showa Plastics Co Ltd, Nomura/Jafco Investment Asia Ltd, Asahi Chemical Industries Co Ltd and the Sumitomo Corp -- had agreed to subscribe or procure subscriptions for 54 million of the shares.
The issue was underwritten by Nomura Singapore Ltd and DBS Bank Ltd.
